verbatim_quote.original: Requirement: forward-reporting of results via the MCP stdio transport; no ports exposed.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Requirement: forward-reporting of results via the MCP stdio transport; no ports exposed.

extracted_decision.summary: Expose blowsh only over MCP stdio transport, with no network ports.
extracted_decision.rationale: Keeps the server local-only and avoids an attack surface.
alternatives: Expose an HTTP port for convenience
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: No remote access without an added transport, in exchange for safety.
